text.card: A red giant 4,063 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.83 solar masses and 13.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,685 K at its surface.
